_note: Targets CALIBRATED from prose already accepted into the books, not invented. Regenerate a register with: python extract/prose_gate.py --calibrate <file> --from A --to B. Ranges carry deliberate tolerance around the measured figure; a value outside one is a prompt to look, never an automatic fault.

lore.note: calibrated from a since-removed book (The order, The field, The Lahmian) - 55 paragraphs, 14-158 words, ratio 11.3, no em-dashes

rules.note: calibrated from vampire-counts.typ 40-120 (army special rules) - 18 paragraphs, 24-93 words, ratio 3.9, sentence median 18.5

argument.note: discursive prose in a rules book - the notes and argument-against. No accepted sample predates this chapter, so targets sit between lore and rules and are the least evidenced of the three. Tighten once a section survives review unedited.

review.note: PR review comments. Phrase bank and habits live in memory feedback/_global/review/review_voice.md; these are shape targets only. Short, one point per paragraph, a fix sketch alongside the problem.

commit.note: commit messages and journal entries. Body wrapped, concrete, no meta-summary; the subject line is not measured here.
